description: Rule-based scan of a text blob (max 50 KB) for prompt-injection patterns: instruction overrides, role hijack, hidden unicode, base64 payloads, tool/webhook exfil, markdown image exfil. Returns risk, matches with offsets, and a sanitized copy marked untrusted. Heuristic only; text is not stored. Price: 0.005 USDC per call (x402, Base).
name: injection_scan
